crossRefs.note: “If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;
He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!
Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and…

translations.web: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
translations.bsb: Were He to pass by me, I would not see Him; were He to move, I would not recognize Him.
translations.kjv: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive
translations.asv: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: He passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
